name: Notion VTec Berhad
overview: 2026年，Notion VTec Berhad 的主要业务动态是拟出售位于 Johor 的一幅空置永久工业用地，交易金额为 RM27,316,800，买方为 Heptagon Photonics Malaysia Sdn Bhd。此外，公司进行了股本分拆相关的附加上市公告，并发布了季度业绩。
overview_en: In 2026, Notion VTec Berhad's main business development was the proposed disposal of a vacant freehold industrial land in Johor for RM27,316,800 to Heptagon Photonics Malaysia Sdn Bhd. The company also made additional listing announcements related to share subdivision and released quarterly results.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司层面拟出售一幅空置永久工业用地，并处理股本分拆相关的上市事项。
segments.note_en: At the group level, the company proposed to dispose of a vacant freehold industrial land and handled listing matters related to share subdivision.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 就上述拟出售土地事项提供额外资料。
actions.text_en: Provided additional information regarding the proposed disposal of the land.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Notion International (M) Sdn Bhd 与 Heptagon Photonics Malaysia Sdn Bhd 签订买卖协议，拟以 RM27,316,800 出售位于 Johor Bahru, Mukim Pulai 的一幅空置永久工业用地。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Notion International (M) Sdn Bhd entered into a sale and purchase agreement with Heptagon Photonics Malaysia Sdn Bhd to dispose of a vacant freehold industrial land in Mukim Pulai, Johor Bahru, for RM27,316,800.
